messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: Missing labels (scale_y_log10)
parts:
Hi,

The y labels is missing in the following example. Does anybody know
what is the best way to get the label automatically shown?

library(ggplot2)
tmp=rbind(
data.frame(x='a', y=rnorm(10, mean=300000, sd=1000))
, data.frame(x='b', y=rnorm(10, mean=300000, sd=1000))
)
p=qplot(x, y, data=tmp)+scale_y_log10()
p


--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Missing labels (scale_y_log10)
parts:
hi,
try this:

qplot(x, y, data=tmp)+scale_y_log10(breaks = pretty(range(tmp$y)))

I think this will be fixed in the future release.
